column1: # ogkm_gamescope_ctrl_audit.tsv — MEASURED privilege gating of the five RM
# control commands SteamOS's gamescope session issues, at every published
# NVIDIA open-gpu-kernel-modules tag nvkvm supports (216 tags, 515.43.04
# through 610.57.04).  Swept 2026-08-28 with tools/ogkm_ctrl_audit.sh.
# WHAT THE COLUMNS MEAN
#   ar_*    the NVOC exported-method accessRight field for that command, read
#           from the generated g_*_nvoc.c export tables.  It is NOT an index:
#           serverControl_InitCookie() memcpys it into rightsRequired.limbs[0]
#           (src/nvidia/src/kernel/rmapi/resource.c:173-175), so it is a
#           one-limb ACCESS MASK.  0x0 = no right required (unprivileged).
#           0x2 = NVBIT(1) = RS_ACCESS_NICE = capable(CAP_SYS_NICE).
#   fl_*    the RMCTRL_FLAGS word for the same entry (informational: every one
#           of these carries NON_PRIVILEGED, which is why the flags word alone
#           is NOT sufficient to judge them -- the accessRight is).
#   nice_primitive   what RS_ACCESS_NICE resolves to on that tag.
#   fifo_get_info_params  the shape of NV2080_CTRL_FIFO_GET_INFO_PARAMS: it is
#           an INLINE array on every tag, never a { count, NvP64 ptr } list, so
#           it carries no guest VA and needs no marshalling.
# THE RESULT, which is uniform across all 216 tags:
#   0x20801109 FIFO_GET_INFO           ar=0x0  -> UNPRIVILEGED -> allowlisted
#   0x20801115 SET_SCHED_POLICY        ar=0x2  -> CAP_SYS_NICE -> no-op only
#   0xa06f0111 RESTART_RUNLIST         ar=0x2  -> CAP_SYS_NICE -> no-op only
#   0xa06f0109 SET_INTERLEAVE_LEVEL    ar=0x2  -> CAP_SYS_NICE -> no-op only
#   0xa06c0110 MAKE_REALTIME           ar=0x2  -> CAP_SYS_NICE -> no-op only
# The five siblings nvkvm ALREADY allows are ar=0x0 on all 216 tags, which is
# why they were safe and these four are not.  0xa06c0107, the TSG twin of
# SET_INTERLEAVE_LEVEL, is ar=0x2 and is likewise absent from the allowlist.
# Reasoning and verdict: docs/reference/gamescope-scheduling-controls.md
